principles: Academic VERIFIED is necessary but not sufficient for production release.
HOLD and REJECTED QuestionGroups must never enter the canonical snapshot.
A visual-required group enters the internal canonical snapshot only when its registry status is READY_SOURCE_CROP.
A missing source visual must remain blocked; no reconstructed or fabricated image is allowed.

Canonical snapshot materialization may preserve reviewed taxonomy codes while those taxonomy artifacts are still staging, but production release must remain blocked until curriculum taxonomy is canonical.
Source rights REVIEW_REQUIRED blocks production distribution even when academic review and visual extraction pass.
Do not invent difficulty, exam_weight, cognitive_level, or explanations. Missing required DB scoring metadata remains a production-import blocker.
Do not flatten a TRUE_FALSE_FOUR QuestionGroup into four unrelated production questions. Group identity and scoring policy must be preserved.
Existing group_review promotion_ready fields remain false in this phase.

required: exactly 4 reviewed children labelled a,b,c,d in order 0..3
each child has TRUE/FALSE trusted answer
each child has reviewed ProblemType/Concept/LearningOutcome mappings
visual not required OR visual registry status == READY_SOURCE_CROP
rights_status cleared by an explicit reviewed source-rights decision
curriculum taxonomy imported/canonical and codes resolve deterministically
trusted Question + QuestionGroup import/promotion lifecycle exists
reviewed deterministic difficulty and exam_weight policy exists
visual asset distribution rights are cleared when visual is required

canonical_materialization.group_key: reuse group_candidate_id as immutable external lineage key; do not mint DB UUIDs in data files
canonical_materialization.child_taxonomy: copy reviewed problem_types, concepts, learning_outcomes and taxonomy_basis exactly
canonical_materialization.source_lineage: copy source_code/subsource/pages/source_evidence_id/review batch without rewriting raw staging
canonical_materialization.visual_reference: for visual groups reference visual_asset_id; never embed image bytes/base64
